DropTriggerStmt.doc: Parsed DROP TRIGGER statement. `if_exists` reflects the IF EXISTS clause; `name` is the trigger identifier. Schema-qualified names are deferred. Whether the trigger actually exists is a runtime concern owned by /parts/storage/parts/triggers — this AST never carries existence state.

DropTriggerParseOk.doc: Successful parse output: the DropTriggerStmt plus the index of the next un-consumed token (positioned BEFORE any outer ';' / Eof).

parse_drop_trigger.doc: Parse a `DROP TRIGGER [IF EXISTS] <name>` statement. Token at `start` MUST be KwDrop and tokens[start+1] MUST be KwTrigger; the statement router is responsible for dispatching to this leaf only on that two-token prefix. Rejects schema-qualified trigger names with `deferred: schema-qualified trigger name`.
